name: MakoChat
author: makologics

sections.description:
MakoChat puts an AI receptionist on your WordPress site. It is trained on your entire website, answers visitor questions around the clock, books real appointments on your calendar (via a free Cal.com connection), and emails you every lead with the full conversation — so your business never misses another customer.

What it does

  • Answers visitors 24/7, trained on every page of your website (it re-reads your site automatically)
  • Books real appointments on your Google/Outlook calendar
  • Captures every lead — name, phone, what they need — and emails it to you instantly
  • Looks great: a clean chat bubble in your brand color

What you need

A MakoChat account (plans from $39/month, self-setup in about 15 minutes — or have the Mako Logics team set everything up for you). This plugin connects your WordPress site to your MakoChat assistant; conversations are processed by the MakoChat service.

External Services

This plugin connects to MakoChat (https://makochat.app), a service operated by Mako Logics LLC — the same company that publishes this plugin.

  • What is loaded: the plugin enqueues one script, https://makochat.app/embed.js, which displays the chat bubble and chat window (in an iframe served from makochat.app).
  • What data is sent, and when: when a site visitor opens the chat and sends a message, that message (and any contact details the visitor chooses to share, such as a name or phone number) is sent to the MakoChat service to generate the AI reply and deliver leads to the site owner. The page’s hostname is also sent so the widget only operates on websites the account owner has authorized. No data is sent for visitors who never interact with the chat beyond the script loading.
  • Who it is sent to: Mako Logics LLC (MakoChat). Service terms: https://makochat.app/terms · Privacy policy: https://makochat.app/privacy · Security details: https://makochat.app/trust

The plugin makes no other external requests and collects no data itself.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → MakoChat.
  3. Paste your Widget ID (shown in your MakoChat dashboard under “Put it on your website”).
  4. Save — the chat bubble is live on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a MakoChat account?

Yes — the plugin displays your MakoChat assistant. Create one at makochat.app (plans from $39/month, free to set up).

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin adds one small deferred script; the chat itself loads in an isolated frame and never blocks your pages.

The bubble covers a button on my site

Settings → MakoChat → raise “Bubble height from bottom” until it clears.

Where is visitor data processed?

Conversations are processed by the MakoChat service (makochat.app), operated by Mako Logics LLC. See https://makochat.app/privacy and https://makochat.app/trust for the full picture.
